user.title: ES Varmepumpe – Loginoplysninger
user.description: Indtast dine loginoplysninger til myheatpump.com-portalen. Integrationen logger ind automatisk og henter alle sensordata. Har du en EU-konto? Vælg https://eu.myheatpump.com fra listen.

data.mode_source_entity: Kilde til driftstilstand (unødvendig siden v2.4.0 – enheden melder tilstanden i par1)
data.dhw_margin_k: Fremløbets margin over varmesætpunktet, der markerer varmt brugsvand (K)
data.flow_entity: Flowsensor (valgfri – har forrang over konstanterne, anbefales ved modulerende cirkulationspumpe)
data.model: Varmepumpemodel – valget udfylder det nominelle flow fra databladet
data.enable_writes: Allow writing to the unit (off by default — required for settings entities, the restore service and parameter_setzen)
data.settings_interval: Configuration poll interval (seconds) — settings change rarely, 900 is plenty
data.backup_interval_h: Automatic backup interval (hours) — a change is always backed up immediately, this is the idle heartbeat
data.backup_keep: Number of backups to keep (0 = unlimited). Backups taken before a write or a restore are never deleted.

error.invalid_auth: Login mislykkedes — forkert brugernavn eller adgangskode.
error.cannot_connect: Forbindelse til portalen mislykkedes. Tjek URL (EU-brugere: https://eu.myheatpump.com) og dit netværk.

origami_theme_missing.title: Origami theme not installed
origami_theme_missing.description:
The ES Heatpump dashboard is set to the "Origami" design, but the theme "{theme}" is not installed. Until it is, Home Assistant shows the default theme.

To install: Marketplace/HACS → download the repository "hazymorning/origami" (category theme), then run the action "frontend.reload_themes" under Developer tools → Actions. The Montserrat font is optional, see the Origami README. This notice then disappears by itself.
